Jim Vieira joins Danny Jones to argue that the Smithsonian hid proof of giant people in ancient America. The episode title calls it a cover-up of the lost giants. Vieira points to old news reports and bone finds as his proof.

Vieira tells how reports of huge skeletons once ran in papers across the land. He claims the finds were taken, filed away, and then lost on purpose. Jones asks why a museum would hide such a prize. Listeners get the giant lore in full, with names, dates, and places to check. The library holds the talk as an archive record of the claim.

Health coach Gary Brecka's work with UFC chief Dana White is the subject of a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. White has said Brecka's testing and program changed his health and, by one famous estimate, saved his life. Rogan takes up the story in detail.

The talk covers the blood work and gene tests Brecka used, and the diet, sleep, and training changes that followed for White. Rogan asks what parts of the method a normal listener could copy. The segment is a case study in the biohacking world the show often visits, told through one dramatic before-and-after.
